headline: Earnings surge on wider margins and merger-fueled growth
summary_short: Prosperity Bancshares' Q2 FY2026 net income rose 24.7% y/y to $168.6 million ($1.67 diluted EPS, +17.6% y/y) as tax-equivalent net interest margin widened to 3.47% and the bank completed its merger with Stellar Bancorp (52 offices, $10.4 billion in assets) on July 1, 2026.
summary_long: Net interest income rose 23.5% y/y to $330.6 million as tax-equivalent NIM widened to 3.47% (+29bp y/y), aided by asset repricing and the American and Southwest Bancshares mergers completed earlier in 2026. Noninterest income grew 41.2% y/y to $60.7 million on an $8.2 million Visa Class B-2 stock-exchange gain; noninterest expense rose to $176.2 million on merger costs. Excluding the Visa gain and merger expenses, net income was $162.7 million ($1.62 diluted EPS), up 20.4% and 14.1% y/y. Nonperforming assets stayed low at 0.34% of average earning assets with no credit-loss provision. Total assets reached $43.9 billion and deposits were $32.6 billion. Subsequent to quarter-end, Prosperity completed its acquisition of Stellar Bancorp ($10.4 billion in assets) on July 1, 2026.
